messages:
deploy-bot: Starting config-only deploy to production. Change window 2026-03-21 10:30-11:30 UTC. Canary plan: 2% for 15m -> 10% for 30m -> 100% if metrics stable. Deploy id dpl-6832101234. Patch includes routing, timeouts, batching. See dashboard: https://dash/release/dpl-6832101234

maria: ack — watching dashboards. No model changes, just infra/config params.

sam: heads up — we saw KV cache pressure on a previous 2% canary for long-context tenants. Recommend lowering batch.max_tokens to 256 in the patch.

tess: +1 to smaller batch and reduce max concurrent per-tenant. I'll be on call during the window.

oncall-sre: I'll take pager for the window. Rollback criteria: p99 latency >= 1.2x baseline for 5m OR error rate increase > 0.5% sustained for 3m.

release-bot: Applying config patch v2026-03-21-009 to cluster prod/us-east-1. Diff (excerpt):
```yaml
routing:
  traffic_weight_adjust: 0.02
  fallback_policy: strict
timeouts:
  inference_ms: 3500
batching:
  max_tokens: 256
  max_concurrent_requests_per_tenant: 8
caching:
  prefix_cache: true
```

deploy-bot: Canary started -> 2% traffic routed to config v2026-03-21-009. Monitoring: dashboards/dpl-6832101234 (latency/errors/cpu/memory/kv-hit).

maria: Canary metrics 5m: error rate stable, p99 +3% (within soft threshold).

sam: traces show slight tail increase for seq_len > 1024 tenants. Hold ramp to 10% for another 10m while I dig in.

tess: agreed hold. Also request: pin heavy customers to previous config until we confirm stability (tenant ids: acme, bigco).

release-bot: Applied tenant pins: acme, bigco -> pinned to v2026-03-18-004.

deploy-bot: Canary 15m: error_rate +0.02%, p99 latency +5% vs baseline. CPU spike observed for 2m after small traffic bursts but recovered.

maria: metrics look acceptable. Recommend proceeding to 10%.

release-bot: Ramping to 10% now. Note: keeping tenant pins and strict fallback policy.

sam: after ramp, small CPU/memory bump on inference pool-3 for 3m; not correlated with errors. Continuing to observe kv-cache hitrate.

oncall-sre: Watching memory & kv-cache. If cache miss rate > 15% sustained for 10m, we'll consider rollback.

sam: one suggestion — increase kv_cache_ttl to 45s to smooth churn, but prefer not to change TTL in this roll since it's already two parameter classes.

tess: agree. Do not change TTL here. If we need cache tuning, do a follow-up config-only deploy.

release-bot: Scheduled full rollout at +2h from now unless rollback triggers. Release note drafted: "Config-only tune: reduced batching max_tokens to 256, tightened inference timeout to 3500ms, routing weight adjustments; tenant pins applied for heavy customers."

deploy-bot: If rollback required, run: `/deploy rollback dpl-6832101234` or use the console rollback button.

tess: I'll give final signoff after another 45m if graphs stay green. :eyes:

maria: thanks — will post final status. :thumbsup:

release-bot: Final status update queued. No rollback triggered so far. Next checkpoint at +60m.
